slides.title: A bad day isn't *starting over*.
slides.sub: One slip doesn't erase the weeks before it.

slides.title: Notice the all-or-nothing.
slides.body: "I blew it, so what's the point?" That thought turns one rough day into a reason to quit.

slides.title: Count what's still there.
slides.body: What you practiced last week didn't vanish today. You still know what you know.

slides.title: Make the next step tiny.
slides.body: Don't plan a fresh start Monday. Do the smallest version of the thing tomorrow.

slides.title: Ask one question.
slides.body: Not "Why did I fail?" Try "What got in the way today, and what would help next time?"
